import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np

# ---------- data ----------
eps     = [0.03, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 1.42]
obs_sr  = [16,   13,   19,   22,   19,   17]
per_sr  = [14,   14,   11,   11,    4,    0]
argmin  = 12

# ---------- style ----------
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.8,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.8,
    'xtick.direction': 'in',
    'ytick.direction': 'in',
    'xtick.major.pad': 4,
    'ytick.major.pad': 4,
    'legend.framealpha': 0.9,
    'legend.edgecolor': '0.8',
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 3.2))

# ---------- collapse shading ----------
# shade perdof collapse region (eps >= 0.3)
ax.axvspan(0.27, 1.8, color='#FFCCCC', alpha=0.35, zorder=0)
ax.text(0.62, 1.8, 'collapse\nregion', fontsize=8, color='#CC4444',
        ha='center', va='bottom', fontstyle='italic')

# ---------- baselines ----------
ax.axhline(argmin, color='0.55', ls='--', lw=1.0, zorder=1, label='Argmin (selection-only)')

# ---------- main curves ----------
ax.plot(eps, obs_sr, '-o', color='#2166AC', lw=1.8, ms=6, mew=0,
        zorder=3, label='Obs-Only CRM')
ax.plot(eps, per_sr, '-^', color='#D6604D', lw=1.8, ms=6, mew=0,
        zorder=3, label='Per-DOF CRM')

# ---------- peak annotation ----------
peak_idx = np.argmax(obs_sr)
ax.plot(eps[peak_idx], obs_sr[peak_idx], '*', color='#2166AC',
        ms=14, mew=0, zorder=4)
ax.annotate(f'{obs_sr[peak_idx]}%',
            xy=(eps[peak_idx], obs_sr[peak_idx]),
            xytext=(eps[peak_idx] * 1.5, obs_sr[peak_idx] + 1.5),
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#2166AC',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#2166AC', lw=0.8),
            zorder=5)

# ---------- perdof zero annotation ----------
ax.annotate('0%',
            xy=(1.42, 0), xytext=(1.0, 3),
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#D6604D',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#D6604D', lw=0.8),
            zorder=5)

# ---------- axes ----------
ax.set_xscale('log')
ax.set_xlim(0.025, 1.8)
ax.set_ylim(-1, 26)

ax.set_xticks(eps)
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(
    lambda v, _: 'uncapped' if v > 1.0 else f'{v:g}'))
ax.xaxis.set_minor_formatter(mticker.NullFormatter())
ax.tick_params(axis='x', which='minor', length=0)

ax.set_xlabel('Correction Magnitude Norm ($\\varepsilon$)', fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel('10-Task Success Rate (%)', fontsize=11)

# ---------- grid ----------
ax.grid(True, which='major', ls='--', lw=0.4, color='0.82', zorder=0)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# ---------- legend ----------
ax.legend(loc='upper right', fontsize=8.5, handlelength=1.8,
          borderpad=0.4, labelspacing=0.35)

fig.tight_layout(pad=0.4)

# ---------- save ----------
out = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_8/projects/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/artifacts/'
fig.savefig(out + 'magnitude_curve.pdf', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
fig.savefig(out + 'magnitude_curve.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
print('saved: magnitude_curve.pdf, magnitude_curve.png')

import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mticker
import numpy as np

# ---------- data ----------
eps     = [0.03, 0.05, 0.10, 0.20, 0.30, 1.42]
obs_sr  = [16,   13,   19,   22,   19,   17]
per_sr  = [14,   14,   11,   11,    4,    0]
argmin  = 12

# ---------- style ----------
plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'serif',
    'font.serif': ['Times New Roman', 'DejaVu Serif'],
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.linewidth': 0.8,
    'xtick.major.width': 0.8,
    'ytick.major.width': 0.8,
    'xtick.direction': 'in',
    'ytick.direction': 'in',
    'xtick.major.pad': 4,
    'ytick.major.pad': 4,
    'legend.framealpha': 0.9,
    'legend.edgecolor': '0.8',
})

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(4.5, 3.2))

# ---------- collapse shading ----------
# shade perdof collapse region (eps >= 0.3)
ax.axvspan(0.27, 1.8, color='#FFCCCC', alpha=0.35, zorder=0)
ax.text(0.55, 7.5, 'collapse\nregion', fontsize=8, color='#CC4444',
        ha='center', va='bottom', fontstyle='italic')

# ---------- baselines ----------
ax.axhline(argmin, color='0.55', ls='--', lw=1.0, zorder=1, label='Argmin (selection-only)')

# ---------- main curves ----------
ax.plot(eps, obs_sr, '-o', color='#2166AC', lw=1.8, ms=6, mew=0,
        zorder=3, label='Obs-Only CRM')
ax.plot(eps, per_sr, '-^', color='#D6604D', lw=1.8, ms=6, mew=0,
        zorder=3, label='Per-DOF CRM')

# ---------- peak annotation ----------
peak_idx = np.argmax(obs_sr)
ax.plot(eps[peak_idx], obs_sr[peak_idx], '*', color='#2166AC',
        ms=14, mew=0, zorder=4)
ax.annotate(f'{obs_sr[peak_idx]}%',
            xy=(eps[peak_idx], obs_sr[peak_idx]),
            xytext=(eps[peak_idx] * 0.55, obs_sr[peak_idx] + 2.5),
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#2166AC',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#2166AC', lw=0.8),
            zorder=5)

# ---------- perdof zero annotation ----------
ax.annotate('0%',
            xy=(1.42, 0), xytext=(0.85, 3.5),
            fontsize=9, fontweight='bold', color='#D6604D',
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='->', color='#D6604D', lw=0.8),
            zorder=5)

# ---------- axes ----------
ax.set_xscale('log')
ax.set_xlim(0.025, 1.8)
ax.set_ylim(-1, 26)

ax.set_xticks(eps)
ax.xaxis.set_major_formatter(mticker.FuncFormatter(
    lambda v, _: 'uncapped' if v > 1.0 else f'{v:g}'))
ax.xaxis.set_minor_formatter(mticker.NullFormatter())
ax.tick_params(axis='x', which='minor', length=0)

ax.set_xlabel('Correction Magnitude Norm ($\\varepsilon$)', fontsize=11)
ax.set_ylabel('10-Task Success Rate (%)', fontsize=11)

# ---------- grid ----------
ax.grid(True, which='major', ls='--', lw=0.4, color='0.82', zorder=0)
ax.set_axisbelow(True)

# ---------- legend ----------
ax.legend(loc='upper left', fontsize=8.5, handlelength=1.8,
          borderpad=0.4, labelspacing=0.35)

fig.tight_layout(pad=0.4)

# ---------- save ----------
out = '/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0509_8/projects/acr-vla-conformal-refinement/artifacts/'
